restriction: Retains real analyticity (and hence smoothness), strict positivity, integrability, total mass one, the infinite nonnegative slice integral at zero, and integrability of every nonzero slice. Omits boundedness; the logistic slice formula and its separate normalization; the joint CDF and everywhere mixed-derivative assertions; the limiting value of the zero-slice integrand; positivity of the nonzero slice integrals; and the marginal CDF assertion of no finite derivative at zero. States only these density and extended-integral facts; it does not establish a refutation of the pointwise marginal-PDF identity under the usual assumption that its real slice integral exists finitely.
